title: Anvesa Model Configuration Schema (v1)
description: One built-in encoder (embedder/models/<id>.json): where its files come from, pinned by size and SHA-256, and how to run it. After adding or changing a file, run: bun run embedder/scripts/gen-model-index.ts

id.description: Stable id, used in config, on disk, and as the model key of stored vectors. Matches the file name.

family.description: anvesa-code: anvesa's own encoders, one per tier. open: open-licence models used only when named.

tier.description: The compute tier an anvesa-code model fills. Open models have none.

retired.description: Ids that were built in and are not any more, for which this model is the replacement.

repo.description: Upstream repository the files come from.

revision.description: The upstream commit the files are fetched at. Absent: main, for repositories anvesa publishes.

modelData.description: External weights of a model over 2 GB, kept under the name the model refers to them by.

ranker.description: The learned ranker fit on this encoder's scores (XGBoost JSON).

maxTokens.description: Input window, in tokens, special tokens included.

cardForm.description: How cards are reshaped before this model embeds them. Absent: as indexed.

summary.description: What the model is good for, in a few words, for a table row.
